shared_elements: upright tall slab carved in relief
figures arranged in stacked horizontal registers/bands
animal or creature forms shown in profile
a horizontal band of small repeated elements
a row of repeated similar heads/units across the top
justification: Both are tall upright surfaces whose relief content is divided into stacked horizontal registers, each containing profile creature/figure forms, and both include a band of small repeated units running across the width. Beyond that generic scheme the content differs sharply: A is densely packed with human-like figures, headdresses, and blocks of sign-like cartouches filling every space in deep overlapping relief, while B shows a few isolated, widely spaced schematic animals (quadruped, birds, snake-like forms) in shallow relief on an empty ground, with no human figures or sign blocks.
